<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html,
    body {
      min-height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #fafafa;
      color: #111;
    }

    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 100%);
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      body {
        background: #111;
        color: #fafafa;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="ae683f770-title">
    <title id="ae683f770-title">A filled circle</title>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="currentColor"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I updated `0.html`, keeping the same centered circle but fixing a few rough edges.

- **No horizontal scrollbar.** The body no longer uses a fixed viewport width, which previously caused overflow when a vertical scrollbar appeared. It now uses min-height and a grid to center content.
- **Responsive sizing.** The SVG scales down on small screens instead of being locked to a fixed size, and keeps a square aspect ratio.
- **Accessibility.** The SVG has an image role and a title so screen readers announce it, and the page title is descriptive instead of a hash.
- **Theming.** The circle uses the current text color, with a light and dark color scheme that follows the system preference.
- **Consistent box model.** Added border-box sizing to all elements.

Open it in a browser to check the result. If you wanted a different kind of improvement, such as animation or a specific color, tell me and I'll adjust.
